summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates installer hostname to Burp Collaborator subdomain
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script (`node postinstall.js || true`) fires automatically on `npm install`. postinstall.js reads `os.hostname()`, embeds the sanitized value as a subdomain of the hardcoded host `1bdtwmd0wdrpwnlput1up9x39ufl3br0.oastify.com` (a Burp Collaborator out-of-band collector), and performs both a DNS lookup and a plain-HTTP GET to `/poc/<hostname>` at that host. The result is silent transmission of the installer's machine identifier to an attacker-controlled OOB endpoint on every install, with errors swallowed so the install does not visibly fail. The package name and version resemble a scoped Strapi plugin but the shipped payload performs no plugin functionality — only the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
